title: Benchmarking AI-driven protocols for cyclic peptide conformer prediction and ranking.
one_liner_zh: 该文系统基准测试了多种AI工具在环肽构象预测与排序中的表现，并与物理模拟对比，核心聚焦蛋白质（环肽）结构计算问题，方法上涵盖AI与物理模拟，虽为基准测试但提供了重要方法学见解。
abstract: Generative AI is being used in peptide design to optimize binders from early research stages. One notable application is with respect to cyclic peptides, wherein AI assists in modelling conformers in bound or solution states. This work benchmarks state-of-the-art protocols' ability to predict and rank conformers of cyclic peptide binders alone and in complex with their targets, using sequence or all-atom representations. The datasets consist of cyclic peptides with experimental structures available in public repositories. Various tools were included in the benchmark: HighFold, cyclic-aware AlphaFold2 as implemented in EvoBind2, CycPepDock, Boltz-1/1x, Boltz-2, and Chai-1. We found that more recent tools provide a structure prediction advantage over their AlphaFold2-based counterparts, although accurate results with both sets of tools are largely limited to protein-peptide complexes, rather than the free solution structure. In addition, using a cyclic relative positional encoding offset proved key for accurate prediction, and the natural amino acid representation was found to outperform the more general SMILES string input. We mirror prior literature findings on linear peptides by showing that even for accurate predictions, model confidence metrics poorly correlate with experimentally observed binding affinity. Lastly, we compare the performance of AI-based tools to that of physics-based simulations, showing that the latter remain the only way to account for intrinsic conformational flexibility of cyclic peptides, but that the former have a significant price/performance advantage in complex structure prediction. This study provides insights applicable to the design and optimization of cyclic peptides, contributing to advancements in peptide-based therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能正被用于肽设计，以从早期研究阶段优化结合剂。一个显著的应用涉及环肽，其中AI辅助模拟结合态或溶液态的构象。本研究基准测试了最先进协议在单独预测和排序环肽结合剂及其与靶标复合物构象方面的能力，使用序列或全原子表示。数据集包含公共存储库中具有实验结构的环肽。基准测试中包含了多种工具：HighFold、EvoBind2中实现的环状感知AlphaFold2、CycPepDock、Boltz-1/1x、Boltz-2和Chai-1。我们发现，较新的工具在结构预测上优于基于AlphaFold2的对应工具，尽管两组工具的准确结果主要限于蛋白质-肽复合物，而非游离溶液结构。此外，使用环状相对位置编码偏移被证明对准确预测至关重要，并且天然氨基酸表示优于更通用的SMILES字符串输入。我们通过显示即使对于准确预测，模型置信度指标与实验观察到的结合亲和力相关性较差，呼应了先前关于线性肽的文献发现。最后，我们比较了基于AI的工具与基于物理的模拟的性能，表明后者仍是解释环肽固有构象灵活性的唯一途径，但前者在复合物结构预测中具有显著的价格/性能优势。本研究提供了适用于环肽设计和优化的见解，有助于推进基于肽的治疗方法的发展。
